layout_note: ICSE 2025 Distinguished Paper: Early Detection of Performance Regressions by Bridging Local Performance Data and Architectural Models. Pre-mounted TeaStore + TrainTicket sources, optional JMeter and Zenodo replication (QPN models/scripts/results).
paper_title: Early Detection of Performance Regressions by Bridging Local Performance Data and Architectural Models
copy_note: Shared subject mount is read-only. Copy TeaStore/TrainTicket under project/ before busy-wait injection, Kieker instrumentation, or rebuilds. Write metrics under project/ or results/.

instance_counts.paper_runtime: Podman 4.6.2 + podman-compose 1.0.6; JMeter load driver; Kieker instrumentation
instance_counts.note: Zenodo package size varies; if replication/ empty, download DOI manually. Nested Docker daemon not guaranteed for all agent tools.

python_environment.note: OpenJDK 17 + Maven for building subjects; Docker CLI/Compose for deployment when daemon available; JMeter for system-level oracle workloads.

toolchain.containers: docker CLI + compose v2 (paper: podman + podman-compose)
toolchain.monitoring: Kieker (instrument at runtime; not vendored in shared mount by default)

paper_protocol.stats: effect size (Cliff's Delta); p-value thresholds as in paper tables

not_provided.zenodo_if_unreachable: Place files under replication/ from https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.13135986
not_provided.kieker_agent_jar: Obtain from Kieker releases if full instrumentation needed
not_provided.host_docker_sock_for_all_tools: ResearchClaw mounts docker.sock; other tools may lack nested daemon — prefer component-level + model prediction path
